name: Home Assistant Cloud
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Home Assistant Cloud, self-host smart-home control and use a user-owned remote-access tunnel. The hard boundary is managed remote access, voice integrations, funding for open source, and low-maintenance security, plus sync, integrations, and household adoption.
